title: cSLE1 [JB17001]

Viability was determined using trypan blue staining and measured on a Countess FLII.

Viability was determined using trypan blue staining and measured on a Countess FLII.

Briefly, 12,000 cells were loaded for capture onto the Chromium System using the v2 single cell reagent kit (10X Genomics). Following capture and lysis, cDNA was synthesized and amplified (12 cycles) as per manufacturer's protocol (10X Genomics). The amplified cDNA was used to construct an Illumina sequencing library and sequenced on a single lane of a HiSeq 4000.
data_processing: FASTQ files for each sample (10X chemistry v2) were generated and demultiplexed using Illumina bcl2fastq 2.20.0.422.
For all samples, R1 (26bp) contains a 16bp cell barcode + 10bp UMI barcode and R2 (98bp) contains the biological reads.

A filtered digital gene expression matrix was generated for each gene expression library against the 10X Genomics hg19 reference build (version 1.2.0, GRCh37.82) using 10X Genomics CellRanger count version 2.1.0.
Genome_build: GRCh37.82
